display_information.name: Floater
display_information.description: Keeps your Slack status in step with your focus streak and daily goal.
display_information.long_description: Floater is a floating task tracker that lives above every window on your Mac. This app lets it keep your Slack custom status in step with what you are actually doing: your current focus streak, how long you have focused today, and progress toward your daily goal. It can also post a short end-of-day summary of what you finished to a channel you choose. Nothing is sent to Slack until you turn it on, and you can turn it off at any time from the menu bar.
